china-peking-1921:p0542_2.rationale: Lists newspaper titles with the number of church families subscribing to each, so the table concerns newspaper readership.

china-peking-1921:p0542_3.rationale: Counts and percentages of church families keeping servants, which is a household living-standard indicator. No existing tag covers domestic servants.
review_questions: Propose a tag for domestic servants or household living standards.

china-peking-1921:p0542_4.rationale: Tabulates the amusements reported by families of three churches, such as music, reading and billiards.

china-peking-1921:p0542_5.rationale: Classes church members as inquirers, probationers or baptized, by sex, for three Christian churches.

china-peking-1921:p0543_1.rationale: Gives baptized church members over 14 by sex and church, with percentages and baptized children.

china-peking-1921:p0543_2.rationale: Counts church attendance by sex across the three churches, with percentages of the surveyed group.

china-peking-1921:p0543_3.rationale: Gives Sunday school attendance by sex at the churches, so it concerns both religion and religious instruction.

china-peking-1921:p0544_1.rationale: Counts men and women contributing financially to the churches, with percentages of each group.

china-peking-1921:p0544_2.rationale: Counts church members doing voluntary work, by sex and church, with percentages of the group and of membership.

china-peking-1921:p0544_3.rationale: Breaks down the kinds of voluntary church service, such as preaching and teaching, by sex and church.
